description: Resolves a Sentry event ID to its project and issue details within an accessible Sentry organization.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters to resolve a Sentry event ID to its associated project and issue details within a specific organization.

event_id.description: The unique 32-character hexadecimal identifier of the Sentry event to be resolved.
event_id.title: Event Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization where the event occurred. This specifies the scope for the event lookup.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: RetrieveEventIdForOrganizationRequest

name: retrieve_event_id_for_organization

RetrieveEventIdForOrganizationResponse.description: Output schema containing the resolved information for the Sentry event, including organization, project, issue, and full event details.

event.description: Complete event object containing detailed information including: id, groupID, eventID, projectID, message, title, platform, tags, user info, contexts, entries (stacktraces/messages), dateCreated, dateReceived, fingerprints, and metadata.
event.title: Event

eventId.description: The internal event ID (same as the input event_id).
eventId.title: Event Id

groupId.description: The internal issue/group ID that this event is associated with. Use this ID to query issue-related endpoints.
groupId.title: Group Id

organizationSlug.description: The slug of the organization where the event belongs.
organizationSlug.title: Organization Slug

projectSlug.description: The slug of the project where the event belongs.
projectSlug.title: Project Slug

RetrieveEventIdForOrganizationResponse.title: RetrieveEventIdForOrganizationResponse
